prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a rear-end collision. The patient had 14 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1099; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with ongoing right shoulder pain and reduced range of motion. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the force and direction of the collision. Over the course of fourteen visits, treatment included physical therapy, graded range-of-motion exercises, and home exercise instruction. Treatment continued somewhat longer than is typical for this presentation, with progress tracked at each visit. Examination revealed positive findings in the supraspinatus and impingement testing, supporting a soft tissue injury to the shoulder, while several other orthopedic and neurological tests returned normal results. No prior injury or treatment to the same shoulder is known to this provider. Billing records reviewed for this episode of care show no duplicate or repeated charges for the same services. Current status is improved strength and motion, with continued home exercise and reassessment planned if symptoms persist.
